items.title: Rivian, Tesla and the 'Holly Index': How to trade the new EV Main Street battle
items.summary: Mike Khouw gives a trade on Rivian and Tesla, informed by his wife's recent auto purchase.
items.titleZh: Rivian、特斯拉和“Holly指数”：如何交易新的电动汽车主街之战
items.summaryZh: Mike Khouw根据妻子最近购买汽车的消息，对Rivian和特斯拉进行了交易。

items.title: 'Go out and buy a Dell': President Trump's backing of the PC-maker has shares surging
items.summary: Dell stock surged as much as 9% as the president highlighted a $6.25 billion contribution to Trump Accounts made by Michael Dell, Dell's founder.
items.titleZh: “走出去买一台戴尔”：特朗普总统对这家个人电脑制造商的支持导致股价飙升
items.summaryZh: 戴尔股价飙升9%，总统强调戴尔创始人迈克尔·戴尔向特朗普账户捐款62.5亿美元。

items.title: Microsoft lays off nearly 5,000 employees across Xbox, commercial sales
items.summary: Microsoft cut around 4,800 roles, or 2.1% of its global workforce, on Monday — the latest in a series of layoffs that’s stoking fears of AI replacing jobs. The layoffs will hit Xbox and commercial sales the hardest.
items.titleZh: 微软在Xbox和商业销售部门裁员近5000人
items.summaryZh: 微软周一裁减了约4800个职位，占其全球员工总数的2.1%，这是一系列裁员中的最新一次，这些裁员引发了人们对人工智能取代工作的担忧。裁员将对Xbox和商业销售造成最严重的打击。

items.title: Stockpicker Dan Sundheim had a monster June. Here's how D1 and other Tiger Cubs did.
items.summary: Stock-picking hedge funds are generally performing well in 2026 despite a rough first quarter.
items.titleZh: 拾荒者Dan Sundheim有一个怪物六月。以下是D1和其他老虎小熊队的表现。
items.summaryZh: 尽管第一季度表现不佳，但选股对冲基金在2026年总体表现良好。

items.title: BYD’s flagship electric sedan receives 65,000 locked-in orders
items.summary: The Seal 08 boasts “the power of a million-dollar vehicle,” but can be bought for under $30,000 in China. After it went on sale last week, locked-in orders for BYD’s new flagship electric sedan reached around 65,000 in its first 30 hours.
items.titleZh: 比亚迪旗舰电动轿车收到6.5万份锁定订单
items.summaryZh: 海豹08拥有“百万美元汽车的力量”，但在中国可以以不到3万美元的价格买到。上周上市后，比亚迪新旗舰电动轿车的锁定订单在头30个小时内达到了约6.5万辆。
